remarks: Welcome to this bright and inviting 1-bedroom condo located in the sought-after Chesterfield complex-a gated community with 24-hour security set amid serene, park-like grounds in the heart of Mid-City Stamford. This sunny corner unit features cathedral ceilings, a skylight that fills the space with natural light. The spacious living and dining area offers an easy, open layout ideal for both everyday living and entertaining, with sliders that lead to a generous sized deck-perfect for relaxing or enjoying your morning coffee. A generously sized primary bedroom with excellent closet space, and an in-unit washer and dryer. Residents of Chesterfield enjoy exceptional amenities, including two pools, a clubhouse, plenty of parking and beautifully landscaped grounds. All of this in a dynamite location across the street from Ridgeway Shopping Center, minutes Downtown Stamford, Metro-North, and major highways offering comfort, convenience and a wonderful community lifestyle.
